pnl_risks: FedWatch returned HTTP 403 again - the fourth consecutive daily snapshot with no single-meeting distribution (Sep 28-30 archives plus this build): ZQV26 96.110 is an October monthly (30-day) average EFFR whose average is set almost entirely before the Oct 28 decision - re-price the Wednesday marks before sizing any front-end position.

CRAU26's executed print is thin (97.6375; 63 trades; volume 629) and its quote sides (97.6325/97.64; mid 97.63625) imply ~2.364% quarterly average CORRA spanning both the Oct 28 and Dec 9 decisions; it cannot be decomposed into either and a single small print is not a deep executable market.

Friday's payrolls versus the ~90k pipeline consensus is the week's cheapest way to get hurt: the October average sits only 1.5 bp over the range midpoint and the long end has already been selling (TLT -3.33% on the week); a hot print compounds both, after today's claims (200k consensus), ISM (55.0) and the Fed-speak slate.

The new weight-0.5 GDP/PCE card balances but does not settle the rope, and the BoC hawkish column is still empty by absence, not evidence: a strong September LFS on Oct 9 or an upward retail revision removes the dovish lean with no new BoC communication.

Frame expiry: this view expires at Oct 9 (LFS + Michigan preliminary) and definitively at the Oct 27-28 / Oct 28 decisions; with FedWatch unavailable, the missing direct pricing becomes a view on the data itself.

The CRAU26 capture carries exactly the claimed fields (last 97.6375; 63 trades; volume 629; bid/ask 97.6325/97.64; sizes 275/54; settlement 97.6275; open interest 237,993; expiry 2026-12-16). Live official checks today: the Fed statement shows the raise of the target range to 3-3/4 to 4 percent (3.75-4.00%), approved for release by a 12-0 vote - the payload asserts no vote count, so there is no contradiction to flag; the FOMC calendar shows October 27-28 and December 8-9*; both BoC pages are byte-identical to the captures (2.25% hold; next decisions Oct 28 with MPR, and Dec 9); the Michigan page states the next release: Friday, October 09, 2026 at 10am ET.
